intro: Durotar Tiger Fur is harvested from the fierce tigers roaming the tropical Echo Isles off the southeastern coast of Durotar. The Darkspear trolls rely heavily on these pelts to craft cold-weather blankets, sturdy tents, and durable armor as their refugee population steadily expands.

sections.t: A Vital Resource for the Darkspear
p: In the crowded settlement of Sen'jin Village, resources are perpetually stretched thin. The Darkspear trolls balance the survival of their people against the fragile ecology of their new home, deliberately allowing local tiger populations to thrive until growing needs demand a cull. The thick, hardy furs of the Durotar tigers are carefully cured to produce everyday survival necessities, from basic protective armor to warm blankets that shield the tribe as seasonal weather shifts.

Harvesting these pelts requires crossing open water to the Echo Isles, the lush archipelago south of Durotar that the Darkspear once called home before the witch doctor Zalazane drove them out. Alongside the dangers posed by Zalazane's thralls, stalkers among the thick foliage must contend with the patient, predatory nature of the tigers themselves. Experienced troll hunters like Vel'rin Fang speak of spending entire days motionless in the jungle brush just to secure a single clean kill.
